## A Step That Sends Text to a Model

A request is made once and saved. `run_once()` reads the saved output back on every later render, so the page never codes a document twice and renders without an API key.

```{r}
#| label: code
# coded <- run_once(
#   "label-for-this-run",
#   qlm_code(inputs, codebook, model = models[["main"]], name = "main")
# )
```

A chunk that would always make a request, with no saved output to read, is shown but not run:

```{r}

```
